title: Smashing Drive
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Time, fares, damage
Arcade taxi racing through New York (a port of the arcade game)
Beat the rival cab to the destination before the clock runs out

Taxi with shortcuts and power-ups
Shortcuts go through buildings, subways and rooftops: take them when the arrow points
Power-ups picked up on the road give a short advantage; grab them on the racing line

Beat the time to the destination
Your rival is another cab racing the same fare; ram it and use shortcuts to stay ahead
Hitting traffic slows you down but rarely stops you

New York routes, day and night
Routes in New York, at day, dusk and night; each route is a sequence of fares
Modes on the menu: Arcade, Survival and Head to Head

Power-ups picked up on the road
Time bonus per fare; power-ups are used once

Shortcuts found
Hidden shortcuts per route
Each route has several shortcuts; find them for a faster time

Routes cleared
Routes cleared; best times
Day, dusk and night versions of the routes
